name: Onboarding to activation
goal: Get a new user to first value

steps.title: Welcome and single next step
steps.detail: One clear action, no feature tour.

steps.title: Guided first action
steps.detail: Contextual prompt triggered by the screen the user is on.

steps.title: Nudge if no first action
steps.detail: Sent only to users who haven't hit the activation event.

steps.title: Value proof
steps.detail: Content matched to the segment's intent signal.

steps.title: Split: activated vs not
steps.detail: Activated users move to engagement; others get a final rescue offer.

bestFor: Apps and fintech products where installs don't turn into active users

name: Lead nurture with SLA
goal: Turn MQLs into SQLs before they go cold
kpi: Typical result: MQL to SQL +20%, response time −35%

steps.title: Score and route
steps.detail: Routing rules by intent, geography and owner capacity.

steps.title: Instant acknowledgement
steps.detail: Confirms the request and sets expectations.

steps.title: Escalate to team lead
steps.detail: Automatic reassignment if the owner hasn't responded.

steps.title: Cohort-matched nurture
steps.detail: Content depends on acquisition source and stage.

steps.title: Stage-wise attribution
steps.detail: Credit flows back to the channel and campaign.

bestFor: High-volume lead businesses where sales follow-up is slow

name: Repeat purchase and loyalty

steps.title: Post-purchase confirmation
steps.detail: Sets up the loyalty programme and next reward.

steps.title: Behaviour-based cross-sell
steps.detail: Recommendations from category and browse intent.

steps.title: Reorder reminder
steps.detail: Timed to the segment's median repurchase interval.

steps.title: Incentive with holdout
steps.detail: Offer only where holdout tests show incremental lift.

steps.title: AOV and LTV tracking
steps.detail: Feeds which journeys get scaled.

bestFor: Retail, QSR and marketplaces with weak second purchase

name: Dormant reactivation
goal: Win back lapsed users without paid retargeting

steps.title: Dormancy tier
steps.detail: Tiers by recency and historical value.

steps.title: What's new since you left
steps.detail: Personalised to what they last used.

steps.title: Low-friction return action
steps.detail: One tap back into the product.

steps.title: High-value tier offer
steps.detail: Reserved for the top value tier only.

steps.title: Sunset or hand to paid
steps.detail: Stops spend on users who won't return.

bestFor: Products bleeding paid budget on retargeting lapsed users

name: Migration to Braze
goal: Switch CRM platforms without losing data, sends or reputation

steps.title: Inventory the old platform
steps.detail: Every object, list, property, workflow and template in Salesforce or HubSpot, with an owner and keep/kill decision.

steps.title: Map to Braze schema
steps.detail: Custom attributes, events and purchases defined; data pipeline or CDP sync agreed with engineering.

steps.title: Rebuild, don't copy
steps.detail: Priority journeys rebuilt as real-time Canvases with behaviour triggers and holdouts.

steps.title: Warm up and run in parallel
steps.detail: IP and domain warm-up on engaged users while the old platform still sends.

steps.title: Switch and decommission
steps.detail: Sign-off checklist, suppression sync, then old workflows turned off.

bestFor: Teams moving off Salesforce Marketing Cloud or HubSpot
